harness.notes: GHCR image pinned by digest; live/floci-capabilities.json probes per-AWS-service coverage against it.

identity.description: the block address is a key of the marker map itself, beside tofu-estate

sweep.description: one Azure Resource Graph query per subscription the estate's resources resolve to, matching the marker case-insensitively, through clients built from the azurerm and azapi provider blocks' own connection arguments (Substrate.NewSweeper; GitHub issue #1120)

controller_held.mechanism: the object's ARM managedBy property when it names an AKS managed cluster or a managed application (the lifecycle owners of a node or managed resource group; an attached disk's managedBy is its VM and is not a hold), or a tag AKS writes on its node resource group (aks-managed- prefix, case-insensitive; AKS FAQ)

untaggable.definition: an azurerm type whose schema carries no ARM tags map (live/readiness.json azure.azurerm.types facts.taggable=false); through azapi_resource, 2366 of 3397 ARM types take no tags at their latest API version (azure.azapi.types), all declaration-carried, not counted here

rows.fence: Resource-group RBAC per principal (a custom role or Contributor on the estate's groups), plus Azure Policy on the tofu-estate tag: deny a write that lacks it or changes it. The RBAC alone governs deletes; a denyAction delete lock is opt-in (deleteLock, off by default). Template files an operator applies, never plan resources.
